C0161.title: Two Sentenced for Selling Genshin Impact Cheat Program, Earning Over 50,000 Yuan Illegally
C0161.summary: Defendants Liu and Wang sold the 'KQ' cheat program for Genshin Impact, which provided functions such as mob vacuum, instant kill, and super speed. Over a period of more than six months, each earned no less than 50,000 yuan illegally.
